positions.title: Senior Data Scientist
positions.description:
- Technical lead of a national loyalty program for medicare members
- Design and implement experiments (A/B testing) and campaigns to inform best marketing strategies, enhance customer retention and members' health outcome
- Develop and deploy machine learning models to enhance targeting and personalization of the loyalty program
- Provide mentorship to junior data scientists. Lead planning meeting. Design technical roadmap

positions.title: Data Scientist, Senior Analytics Consultant
positions.description:
- Developed machine learning models to inform business decisions, reduce operational costs and enhance customer satisfaction, including customer segmentation(clustering), automated assets tagging model (natural language processing/classification), and an PoC of a recommendation engine (collaborative filtering). 
- Automated traditional reporting process using statistical modeling, SQL, Python, Tableau and Excel. Boosted reporting process by saving 90+% work efforts per business cycle

honors.title: BNP PARIBAS ACE Manager Business Competition
honors.description:
•	Participated in a three-week case competition held by BNP PARIBAS on a team of three and solved seven cases related to retail banking, asset management, and corporate and investment banking
•	Ranked in the top 4% among all the 777 participating teams from 145 countries
